title: Exact-deck teacher and replay-safety qualification
decision_resolved: Whether imitation is legally, semantically, and statistically defensible for any specialist before training.
hypothesis: At least one exact 60-card archetype has a recent, settled, policy-consistent teacher corpus with >=25,000 valid meaningful decisions and no unresolved action alignment.
strongest_alternative: Public replay selection is too biased, teacher identity/deck is too uncertain, or labels cannot be authorized; imitation should be abandoned.
inputs_and_provenance: Official episode/deck interfaces; current daily top-episode indices; project semantic replay loader; exact deck SHA-256; teacher/rating/date receipts. Raw bodies are not in this audit pack and must be acquired under separate authorization.
deck: Mega Lucario default; Starmie challenger; Dragapult as high-complexity comparator.
teacher_or_opponent_population: At least 2 independent strong teachers per candidate, plus lower-rated and losing episodes for coverage diagnostics.
choice_game_update_budget: 0 training choices; target >=200 episodes and >=25k meaningful decisions for a passing deck.
checkpoint_resume_plan: Versioned acquisition manifest; content hashes; append-only audit; no mutable labels.
primary_metric: Valid full-action label rate, exact-deck certainty, teacher consistency, duplicate-adjusted episode/decision count, matchup/time coverage.
negative_controls: Attempt parsing intentionally shifted actions; cross-deck teacher mixing; duplicate episodes; forced/setup rows.
screening_threshold: One candidate with exact legal 60-card list, >=1 strong teacher, >=5k valid decisions, zero unresolved labels.
confirmation_threshold: Exact list + >=2 independent recent teachers + >=25k meaningful decisions + episode-level dedup/splits + zero unresolved labels + documented license/authorization.
catastrophic_stop_conditions: Any hidden/private leakage, invalid labels, deck mismatch, unauthorized data use, duplicate contamination across splits, or unresolved compound-action reconstruction.
pass_next_action: Authorize E02/E03 for the passing deck through a new decision record.
fail_next_action: Stop imitation; retain deterministic hedge and run only bounded PPO canary after E04.
ambiguous_next_action: Acquire the smallest missing sample or a second teacher; do not train.
entry_gate: Read-only acquisition/analysis authorization and official rules check.
priority_rationale: It can invalidate the recommended path before any material compute and resolves the largest unknown.

title: Minimal CABT actor/learner bridge qualification
decision_resolved: Whether the proven PPO components can operate on real CABT trajectories without semantic, recurrent, or lifecycle corruption.
hypothesis: A minimal bridge can reproduce stored compound log-probabilities, attach both-player boundaries, and run 100 games with zero reliability events before any optimizer step.
strongest_alternative: Integration defects dominate and make both on-policy evaluation and fine-tuning unsafe.
inputs_and_provenance: Frozen G1/G2/G3a source/configs, exact engine/card/deck hashes, rule opponents, no training.
deck: Mega Lucario engineering candidate plus Mega Abomasnow smoke anchor.
teacher_or_opponent_population: Random legal and included rule agents.
model_initialization: Frozen G2 checkpoint or deterministic freshly initialized policy for no-update qualification.
trainable_parameters_and_losses: No optimizer steps; all parameters frozen.
compute_platform: Local/private CPU first; T4x2 only after local pass.
checkpoint_resume_plan: Attempt-scoped manifests; exact request/action traces; deterministic bridge resume test.
primary_metric: Zero invalid/fallback/stale/out-of-order/owner-crossing events; old compound log-prob max error <=1e-5; terminal/truncation classification 100%.
negative_controls: Injected stale request, duplicate action index, worker death, forced-only step, partial multi-select/STOP, two-player terminal ordering.
screening_threshold: 10 games complete with zero reliability events and exact action replay.
confirmation_threshold: 100 games and >=10k decisions, zero reliability events, deterministic checkpoint/resume parity.
catastrophic_stop_conditions: Any silent fallback, swallowed worker failure, nonzero policy lag, recurrent ownership crossing, unclassified terminal, or replay mismatch.
pass_next_action: Permit E05 and real on-policy evaluation.
fail_next_action: Do not run PPO; fix bridge while BC/offline analysis and deterministic hedge continue.
ambiguous_next_action: Reduce to a single-process trace and classify every discrepancy.
entry_gate: No omitted native asset required for source audit; execution requires authorized private engine.
priority_rationale: It is the hard safety gate for all learned-policy field testing and can run in parallel with data qualification.

title: Native option-order signal ablation
decision_resolved: Whether suppressing raw option position discards a cheap, competition-relevant prior.
hypothesis: A small normalized option-position embedding improves held-out log loss and on-policy strength without creating brittle permutation dependence.
strongest_alternative: Option order is spurious, engine-version-specific, or causes shortcuts that fail under perturbation.
inputs_and_provenance: E01-qualified exact-deck labels; semantic projection; native order retained only in one branch.
deck: First E01-qualified deck, expected Mega Lucario.
teacher_or_opponent_population: Qualified teachers; held-out teacher, time, matchup, and episode splits.
model_initialization: Same seed/model; order-blind control versus position-feature treatment.
trainable_parameters_and_losses: Recurrent autoregressive BC; all G2 parameters trainable; token cross-entropy including STOP.
choice_game_update_budget: 5k labels per arm; 200 screening games per arm against fixed population.
checkpoint_resume_plan: Checkpoint at 1k/5k labels; exact config/model/data hashes.
primary_metric: Held-out full-action NLL and exact match; on-policy paired win-rate delta.
negative_controls: Randomly permuted legal-option order at validation; option-0 deterministic policy; uniform policy; card-ID-only model.
screening_threshold: Position arm improves held-out NLL >=5% relative and no permutation-control collapse >10 pp.
confirmation_threshold: At least +5 pp paired on-policy win rate with no held-out archetype regression >3 pp at >=400 games/arm.
catastrophic_stop_conditions: Illegal action, reliance on missing position at submission, >10 pp collapse under semantically equivalent option permutation, or leakage of teacher action index.
maximum_compute_loss: <=1.5 GPU hours plus <=1 CPU evaluation hour.
pass_next_action: Include position feature with permutation regularization in E03.
ambiguous_next_action: Increase to 25k labels only if offline metrics and 200-game result disagree.
priority_rationale: Forum evidence suggests native order can be unusually strong; this is a cheap, falsifiable architecture decision.

title: Recurrent autoregressive BC scaling pilot
decision_resolved: Whether exact-deck imitation creates on-policy competence rather than only offline accuracy.
hypothesis: Scaling from 5k to 25k to 100k qualified decisions yields monotonic held-out NLL gains and at least a competent rule-baseline-level policy.
strongest_alternative: Teacher/deck entanglement and covariate shift make offline accuracy non-transferable; BC should not be the primary path.
inputs_and_provenance: E01-qualified corpus with episode/teacher/deck/matchup/time splits; E02 feature decision.
deck: Mega Lucario unless E01 selects another deck.
teacher_or_opponent_population: Two or more teachers; validation includes held-out teacher and hard matchups.
model_initialization: G2 architecture; compare random initialization and optional rule-policy distillation initialization.
trainable_parameters_and_losses: All 970,022 parameters; weighted token NLL over legal options; autoregressive without-replacement trace; STOP loss; optional teacher-strength weights; no outcome reward in pilot.
choice_game_update_budget: 5k/25k/100k labels; 3 seeds at 25k and 100k; 200 games/opponent screening, 600 confirmation for promoted checkpoint.
checkpoint_resume_plan: Checkpoints every 5k labels or 15 minutes; retain optimizer/RNG/data cursor and best held-out NLL plus on-policy champion.
primary_metric: Full-action exact match, token NLL, calibration, teacher regret, H2H vs teacher/rule anchors, state-distribution divergence, zero illegal/fallback.
negative_controls: Frequency/order baseline; history-dropped model; shuffled teacher labels; winner-only versus both-player weighting; forced-row loss disabled.
screening_threshold: At 25k: >=25% NLL reduction vs strongest non-neural baseline, >=60% full-action exact match, zero illegal/fallback, and >=30% H2H vs teacher or >=5 pp over deterministic baseline.
confirmation_threshold: At 100k: >=70% full-action exact match, >=40% H2H vs teacher, >=5 pp aggregate over deterministic hedge, no important matchup below 35%, and consistent direction in >=2/3 seeds.
catastrophic_stop_conditions: Offline metrics improve while H2H falls >=5 pp twice; illegal/fallback event; teacher leakage; held-out teacher or matchup collapse >10 pp; no scaling from 25k to 100k.
maximum_compute_loss: <=5 GPU hours and <=6 CPU evaluation hours.
pass_next_action: Promote best BC checkpoint to E05; preserve as rollback submission candidate if runtime-safe.
fail_next_action: Stop imitation expansion; use deterministic hedge and consider a 100k-choice PPO canary only.
ambiguous_next_action: Acquire one targeted DAgger-like rule-teacher slice on learner states or run one additional seed; no 500k-label expansion.
entry_gate: E01 confirmation pass and E02 decision recorded.
priority_rationale: This is the cheapest direct test of the recommended learned path and explicitly rejects the action-accuracy trap.

title: Deterministic specialist hedge and perturbation controls
decision_resolved: Whether a faithfully reproduced rule/copied specialist can remain a competitive, shippable second active agent.
hypothesis: The included Mega Lucario policy plus only validated guards/order conventions is stronger and safer than a generic learned checkpoint during experimentation.
strongest_alternative: The rule policy is stale, overfit to narratives, or too weak for the current meta.
inputs_and_provenance: Included rule-agent source and exact deck; current fixed anchor population; no copied private code.
deck: Mega Lucario; compare Mega Abomasnow and Dragapult rule agents.
teacher_or_opponent_population: Current anchors, historical checkpoints, targeted counters, seat-balanced.
choice_game_update_budget: 400 games/variant for screen; 1,200 for confirmation; no training.
checkpoint_resume_plan: Versioned source/deck tarball; exact deterministic traces; rollback-ready champion.
primary_metric: Meta-weighted win rate, worst important matchup, runtime/failure rate.
negative_controls: Remove each narrative guard; randomize equivalent option order; native policy unchanged; first-legal baseline.
screening_threshold: Variant point estimate >=+5 pp versus original on targeted loss bucket and aggregate not worse by >2 pp.
confirmation_threshold: Aggregate lower bound above original by >0 or mean +3 pp, no important matchup regression >5 pp, zero runtime failures.
catastrophic_stop_conditions: Any invalid action, timeout, narrative fix that fails perturbation control, or aggregate regression >=5 pp.
fail_next_action: Revert to unmodified strongest included rule policy.
ambiguous_next_action: Keep original; do not add the guard.
priority_rationale: Maintains a shippable hedge while learned branches are uncertain.

title: BC to KL-regularized recurrent PPO canary
decision_resolved: Whether bounded on-policy learning improves the teacher-warm-started policy without catastrophic forgetting.
hypothesis: 100k meaningful choices with adaptive KL and an auxiliary BC loss improve held-out population strength by >=5 pp.
strongest_alternative: Sparse reward/nonstationarity destroys BC competence or yields no measurable gain.
inputs_and_provenance: Best E03 BC checkpoint; E04-qualified bridge; frozen opponent population and deck.
teacher_or_opponent_population: 40% deterministic/rule anchors, 30% historical BC/checkpoints, 20% self-play, 10% hard exploiters; frozen per run.
trainable_parameters_and_losses: Recurrent PPO, public critic, GAE; adaptive teacher KL target 0.01-0.03; auxiliary BC minibatch weight decays 1.0 to 0.1; all parameters trainable.
compute_platform: T4x2 preferred; TPU only after E11 qualification.
choice_game_update_budget: 100k meaningful choices = 6 full 16,384-choice updates plus 1,696 remainder; define partial-update handling before launch; 3 seeds only after one-seed screen.
checkpoint_resume_plan: Every update and 25k choices; exact optimizer/RNG/rollout/opponent state; preserve starting BC.
primary_metric: Paired meta-weighted win-rate delta vs starting BC; KL, clip fraction, value calibration, illegal/fallback, matchup floor.
negative_controls: Frozen BC; PPO without auxiliary BC on one small seed; reward-shuffled diagnostic forbidden from promotion.
screening_threshold: At 100k one seed: point estimate >=+5 pp aggregate, no matchup <=-5 pp, KL within target, zero reliability events.
confirmation_threshold: At least 2/3 seeds positive; pooled lower bound >0 improvement at >=600 games/important population; no important matchup floor <35%.
catastrophic_stop_conditions: Aggregate -5 pp, any important matchup -10 pp, KL >0.05 for two updates, entropy collapse, value divergence, illegal/fallback, or resume mismatch.
maximum_compute_loss: <=4 GPU hours for screen; <=8 GPU hours including 3-seed confirmation.
fail_next_action: Revert to BC champion and stop this PPO configuration.
ambiguous_next_action: One additional 100k seed or more evaluation; do not extend the same run to 500k.
priority_rationale: Tests the exact hybrid advantage with a bounded downside and rollback.

title: Starmie specialist challenger gate
decision_resolved: Whether a lower-branching current-meta archetype should replace Mega Lucario as the learned specialist.
hypothesis: A current exact-list Starmie corpus produces faster BC competence and better meta-weighted transfer than Lucario.
strongest_alternative: The apparent Starmie strength is sample-selection bias or stale visible meta; exact list/teacher coverage is insufficient.
inputs_and_provenance: Current official/public episodes and exact public deck source; same E01/E03 protocol.
teacher_or_opponent_population: At least two strong, recent, policy-consistent Starmie teachers.
choice_game_update_budget: 25k labels screen; 100k only if screen passes; equal evaluation budget to Lucario.
primary_metric: Head-to-head and meta-weighted difference vs equal-budget Lucario; sample-efficiency curve.
negative_controls: Same teachers with shuffled outcomes; old versus recent episode window; exact-list mismatch rejection.
screening_threshold: E01 confirmation plus 25k BC meets E03 screen and is >=5 pp above Lucario at equal budget.
confirmation_threshold: At 100k, >=8 pp above Lucario pooled, no catastrophic matchup floor, >=2/3 seeds.
catastrophic_stop_conditions: No exact list, teacher inconsistency, visible-meta-only gain, or any important matchup <30%.
pass_next_action: Switch primary learned specialist to Starmie; retain Lucario deterministic hedge.
ambiguous_next_action: Keep Lucario primary; collect only targeted additional Starmie evidence.
priority_rationale: Potentially high upside, but gated because current exact-list evidence is absent from the archive.

title: 500k-choice hybrid confirmation and historical league
decision_resolved: Whether the successful 100k hybrid gain persists and is large enough to justify final training.
hypothesis: Five staged 100k chunks produce monotonic or recoverable strength gains without forgetting.
strongest_alternative: The canary gain was noise/multiple comparison or plateaus before meaningful field strength.
inputs_and_provenance: Promoted E05 configuration; frozen training/evaluation populations; historical checkpoints.
teacher_or_opponent_population: Rule anchors, teacher, historical checkpoints, held-out exploiters, recent meta decks.
model_initialization: Best confirmed 100k hybrid checkpoint or original BC according to predeclared rule.
trainable_parameters_and_losses: Same E05, with KL/BC schedule frozen before run.
choice_game_update_budget: 500k choices = 30 full updates + 8,480 remainder per seed; 2 seeds screen, third only for confirmation.
checkpoint_resume_plan: 100k chunks; stop and evaluate each chunk; preserve every historical champion.
primary_metric: Meta-weighted paired improvement, lower bound, worst matchup, cross-seed consistency.
negative_controls: Starting BC; 100k champion; historical checkpoint tournament; no result-dependent hyperparameter changes.
screening_threshold: At least one of 200k/300k/500k beats 100k champion by >=3 pp with no catastrophic regression.
confirmation_threshold: 3 seeds or predeclared 2+1 design; candidate-minus-anchor lower bound >2 pp, mean >3 pp, all floors pass at >=3,000 games total.
catastrophic_stop_conditions: Two consecutive chunk regressions >=5 pp, important matchup <35%, reliability event, or compute rate below 35 choices/s.
pass_next_action: Freeze final learned champion and package.
fail_next_action: Return to best earlier BC/hybrid checkpoint; no 5M extension.
ambiguous_next_action: Increase evaluation, not experience, unless uncertainty is demonstrably evaluation-limited.
priority_rationale: Only justified after the 100k experiment proves decision value.

title: Selective search availability, latency, and strength ablation
decision_resolved: Whether bounded search adds value only in uncertain tactical states and fits the real runtime.
hypothesis: Gated 1-8 rollout search improves weak/high-uncertainty decisions without harming a strong policy or exceeding runtime.
strongest_alternative: Search amplifies model error, hidden-state misspecification, or latency and harms strong policies as forum reports indicate.
inputs_and_provenance: Official CABT search API/runtime; packaged candidate; legal hidden-zone hypotheses; no engine modification.
deck: Promoted specialist plus Alakazam tactical comparator if available.
teacher_or_opponent_population: Hard tactical loss buckets and full held-out population.
trainable_parameters_and_losses: None initially; policy/value used for leaf/rerank.
choice_game_update_budget: 0/1/4/8 rollout variants; 200 targeted + 400 aggregate games each.
checkpoint_resume_plan: Versioned search config; per-decision latency trace; immediate fallback to no-search.
primary_metric: Targeted and aggregate win-rate delta; p95/p99 decision and game latency; timeout risk.
negative_controls: No-search; random rollout; search on every state; uncertainty gate shuffled.
screening_threshold: Targeted +5 pp and aggregate >=-2 pp; API present in exact package; p99 game inference <60 s and max projected cumulative <300 s.
confirmation_threshold: Aggregate +3 pp with no matchup -5 pp at 1,200 games; zero timeout; deterministic package parity.
catastrophic_stop_conditions: API absent, hidden-state leakage, manual coin bias, timeout, aggregate -5 pp, or stronger-policy degradation.
pass_next_action: Use only the smallest passing gated search.
ambiguous_next_action: Restrict to one tactical context and rerun; no broader search.
entry_gate: Official runtime/API verification and stable champion.
priority_rationale: Potential tactical upside, but current evidence warns it can harm strong policies and runtime verification is missing.

title: Frozen local tournament and meta-weighted confirmation
decision_resolved: Which checkpoint/deck is the best expected submission and whether a second active path adds portfolio value.
hypothesis: A champion selected by held-out cross-play and worst-matchup floors transfers better than mirror/action-accuracy selection.
strongest_alternative: Visible meta weights are biased and no local population predicts the hidden ladder.
inputs_and_provenance: Training opponents, held-out agents, historical checkpoints, public rules, specialist exploiters, recent visible meta with uncertainty bands.
teacher_or_opponent_population: At least 5 fixed anchors + held-out decks + exploiters; separate training/eval.
choice_game_update_budget: Screen 200 games/cell; confirm 600-1,200/cell for finalists; >=3,000 frozen-population games for champion.
checkpoint_resume_plan: Append-only match manifest; no candidate mutation after tournament begins.
primary_metric: Meta-weighted score with uncertainty, equal-anchor diagnostic, seat split, worst important matchup, reliability/latency.
negative_controls: Mirror-only ranking; random-agent-only ranking; equal versus meta weights; 3/7/14-day meta sensitivity.
screening_threshold: Candidate point estimate >=+5 pp vs current champion and no floor breach.
confirmation_threshold: Probability improvement >0 >=0.99, lower bound >2 pp, mean >3 pp, all floors, runtime/package pass.
catastrophic_stop_conditions: Multiple-comparison-adjusted failure, exploiter collapse, package mismatch, or any reliability event.
pass_next_action: Freeze active pair and submission order.
ambiguous_next_action: Collect more games only for the decision-critical cells using sequential stopping.
entry_gate: At least two frozen, package-ready candidates.
priority_rationale: Prevents leaderboard and mirror overfitting; mandatory before final promotion.

title: Repaired TPU v2 environment qualification
decision_resolved: Whether TPU value comes from host actors, learner, batched inference, or none, and whether it beats T4 information/hour.
hypothesis: The repaired harness confirms >=250 choices/s from host CPU actors and a stable TPU learner without false batch-cap rejection.
strongest_alternative: The first observation was harness artifact; XLA synchronization/recompilation erases benefit.
inputs_and_provenance: Repaired v2 input contract and notebook; exact engine/config hashes; no training.
trainable_parameters_and_losses: No competence training; optional optimizer microbenchmark.
compute_platform: TPU v5e-8 host + TPU learner; compare T4x2.
choice_game_update_budget: 15-minute sweeps 16-96 workers; >=100k choices for stable selected layout.
checkpoint_resume_plan: Attempt-scoped outputs; preserved negative verdicts; no overwrite.
primary_metric: Engine choices/s, model inference/s, optimizer/s, queue delay, host/device utilization, zero harness defects.
negative_controls: CPU-only host with TPU idle; TPU learner only; varying worker count; static-shape compile warm/cold.
screening_threshold: >=100 integrated choices/s and no false cap/recompilation.
confirmation_threshold: >=1.5x T4 information/hour after queueing/optimizer, or unique quota advantage.
catastrophic_stop_conditions: Harness defect, missing receipt, oversubscription collapse, repeated XLA compile, or <35 choices/s.
pass_next_action: Use TPU only for an already-promoted E07 configuration.
ambiguous_next_action: One targeted measurement of the bottleneck; no full competence run.
entry_gate: E05 pass or T4 throughput <100 choices/s; retained v2 outputs required.
priority_rationale: Throughput optimization is secondary until a learning path passes competence gates.

title: Representation ceiling and auxiliary-objective ablation
decision_resolved: Whether explicit deck/prize/belief/turn-plan features are needed after a competence plateau.
hypothesis: Explicit count/belief and auxiliary value/event objectives improve held-out matchup transfer more than increasing model width.
strongest_alternative: The existing recurrent card-ID representation is sufficient; data/policy quality is the bottleneck.
inputs_and_provenance: Qualified data and plateaued champion only.
teacher_or_opponent_population: Held-out matchups emphasizing prizes, deck counts, sequencing, hidden information.
trainable_parameters_and_losses: Add explicit known deck counts, public prize hypotheses, turn-plan tag; auxiliary next-event/value/count losses; compare width-matched control.
choice_game_update_budget: 25k supervised labels or 100k on-policy choices per arm; 400 games/cell.
primary_metric: Held-out hard-matchup win rate and calibration per added parameter/engineering day.
negative_controls: Width-matched model; shuffled auxiliary target; no recurrence; no explicit count feature.
screening_threshold: Hard-matchup +5 pp and aggregate not worse, or held-out NLL >=10% better.
confirmation_threshold: Adjusted lower bound >0 at 1,200 games and no runtime breach.
catastrophic_stop_conditions: Leakage of hidden state, package latency/memory breach, or no gain over width control.
ambiguous_next_action: Target one missing feature; do not redesign the model.
entry_gate: Documented plateau after E03/E05; not a first-72-hour task.
priority_rationale: Potential ceiling fix, but premature before teacher/data/on-policy competence is established.
